correctness.rationale: For every n>=5, a perfect matching containing a rung is uniquely tiled by synchronized horizontal pairs between rungs, indexed by an independent subset of the cyclic square positions. Rung-free cases yield exactly two unmatched frozen states for even prisms and odd Möbius ladders. A legal designated square flip toggles exactly one independent-set bit; deletion before insertion attains Hamming distance. Majority of three independent bitsets is independent, so the connected sector is median; disjoint maximum independent sets prove diameter 2 floor(n/2), while empty set proves radius floor(n/2). Independent direct edge-recursion enumerations confirmed both closures for n=5..8; this is corroboration, not the infinite proof.
